slug: 2024-03-07 Eight years in the making - Tunisia's Biometric ID and Passport Bills risk rights

facts.fact: Access Now reports that the Ministry of Interior's fourth draft biometric ID law was approved by a ministerial council on 30 November 2023, sent to Parliament's Committee on Rights and Freedoms on 25 December 2023, and adopted by an overwhelming majority on 6 March 2024; the document does not mention promulgation.
facts.system: Biometric ID law (Ministry of Interior draft law)
